audience: developers who run databases on Turso and need usage, locations and read-only queries

useCases.title: Check which databases use the most rows
useCases.text: Read the usage of one database per instance, with rows read and written and storage size. Read the organization usage for the billing cycle.

useCases.title: List databases and their hostnames
useCases.text: List the databases of the organization, optionally filtered by group. Read one database to see its hostname and block flags.

useCases.title: Run a read-only SQL query
useCases.text: Run one SQL statement against a database and return its columns and rows. The statement runs with a read-only token, and the result returns at most 200 rows by default.

useCases.title: Review groups, locations and database instances
useCases.text: List the groups of the organization and the regions where a group can run. List the instances of a database, with its primary and replicas.

useCases.title: Create a database in an existing group
useCases.text: Create an empty database in an existing group. Creating a database can start billing.

useCases.title: Mint a read-only database token
useCases.text: Mint a token for one database. Read-only is the default. The returned token is a secret, so treat it like a password.
